title: Pressure in Pregnancy, a Crisis, and Sugar

questions.stem: A pregnant patient has a sustained pressure of 170 over 112. This pressure:

options.text: Can wait until the morning clinic
Is treated with aspirin as the antihypertensive
Is ignored if there is no protein in the urine

questions.explanation: A sustained 160 systolic or 110 diastolic is treated promptly.

questions.stem: Magnesium in preeclampsia with severe features, or in eclampsia, is given for:

options.text: The pressure itself, as a blood-pressure drug
To prevent seizures. It is not a blood-pressure drug

questions.explanation: Magnesium is for preeclampsia with severe features, or for eclampsia, to prevent seizures. It is not a blood-pressure drug. You still treat the pressure separately.

questions.stem: Low-dose aspirin after twelve weeks in a high-risk pregnancy is used to:
questions.explanation: Prevention is low-dose aspirin after twelve weeks. It does not treat a crisis pressure.

questions.stem: Adrenal crisis. The first treatment is:

options.text: A stim test, then steroids if it is positive

questions.explanation: The stim test can wait until the patient is alive.

questions.stem: A stim test in suspected adrenal crisis:

options.text: Must finish before any steroid is given
Can wait; do not delay hydrocortisone and saline

questions.explanation: Do not delay treatment for the confirmatory test.

questions.stem: Gestational diabetes that diet does not control is treated with:

options.text: A beta blocker as first-line sugar treatment

questions.explanation: Insulin is the medicine when diet fails.

questions.stem: After birth, a baby whose mother had gestational diabetes should be watched for:
questions.explanation: The newborn is watched for hypoglycemia.

questions.stem: After pregnancy, a mother who had gestational diabetes:

options.text: Should be rescreened; later type 2 risk remains

questions.explanation: The mother's later type 2 risk remains, and she is rescreened.

questions.stem: Aspirin at a pressure of 170 in preeclampsia:

options.text: Replaces magnesium for seizure prophylaxis in a crisis
Is given instead of delivery planning

questions.explanation: Aspirin is prevention, not the treatment of a crisis pressure.

questions.stem: The blood-pressure numbers that trigger prompt treatment in pregnancy are a sustained:

options.text: 140 over 90 only, always with no further action at 160
